name: usage-observer
description: Local-only Claude Code telemetry: captures agents, subagents, skills, tools, tokens, context and cost into the project's own logs/.

capture.title: Capture file
capture.description: Where the plugin appends its records, relative to the project's main checkout (or absolute).

subagentAlerts.title: Subagent alerts
subagentAlerts.description: Show one transcript line, and one line in the /observer pane, when a subagent passes its size limit or its time limit. Observe only: nothing is stopped.

cacheLine.title: Cache line
cacheLine.description: Show one status line with how long each prompt cache stays warm and what a cold return costs (main and up to three subagents). Observe only: nothing is stopped or sent.
